enum.name: MVK_RX_MODE
enum.description: These values define the status of the receiver.

enum.name: MVK_RX_STATUS
enum.description: These values define the status of the receiver.

enum.name: MVK_RX_ANLG_EN
enum.description: These values define the power on/off of the analog part of the receiver.

enum.name: MVK_ANT_STATES
enum.description: These values define the antenna state of each PCB

enum.name: MVK_RX_STAGES_OPERATION
enum.description: These values define the stages operation mode for all PCBs

entry.name: MVK_STAGES_OPERATION_MANUAL
entry.description: Stages change in manual mode according to user input

entry.name: MVK_STAGES_OPERATION_AUTO
entry.description: Stages change in automatic mode according to automatic change strategy. See confluence

enum.name: MVK_STAGE_STATES
enum.description: These values define the stage states of each PCB

entry.name: MVK_STAGE_1_OFF_STAGE_2_OFF_STAGE_3_OFF_STAGE_4_OFF
entry.description: Stage 1 off, Stage 2 off, Stage 3 off, Stage 4 off

entry.name: MVK_STAGE_1_ON_STAGE_2_OFF_STAGE_3_OFF_STAGE_4_OFF
entry.description: Stage 1 on, Stage 2 off, Stage 3 off, Stage 4 off

entry.name: MVK_STAGE_1_ON_STAGE_2_ON_STAGE_3_OFF_STAGE_4_OFF
entry.description: Stage 1 on, Stage 2 on, Stage 3 off, Stage 4 off

entry.name: MVK_STAGE_1_ON_STAGE_2_ON_STAGE_3_ON_STAGE_4_OFF
entry.description: Stage 1 on, Stage 2 on, Stage 3 on, Stage 4 off

entry.name: MVK_STAGE_1_ON_STAGE_2_ON_STAGE_3_ON_STAGE_4_ON
entry.description: Stage 1 on, Stage 2 on, Stage 3 on, Stage 4 on

enum.name: MVK_CARD_STATE
enum.description: These values define the save states of the system.

enum.name: MVK_SAVE_STATE
enum.description: These values define the save states of the system.

enum.name: MVK_SIGNAL_SAT
enum.description: These values define the boolean states.

enum.name: MVK_SIGNAL_DET
enum.description: These values define the boolean states.

enum.name: MVK_SIGNAL_MASTER_DET
enum.description: These values define the boolean states.

enum.name: MVK_SIGNAL_DET_SENT
enum.description: These values define the boolean states.

enum.name: MVK_RX_RESET
enum.description: These values define the boolean states.

enum.name: MVK_RX_CHG_REQ
enum.description: These values define if a change request has been demanded by the user.

enum.name: MVK_RX_UPDATE
enum.description: These values define the firmware update command states.

entry.name: MVK_UPDATE_TRUE
entry.description: Firmware update requested - enter bootloader mode
